pairs.subject: status-vocabulary
pairs.evidence: src/features/admin/members/MembersTable.tsx:68 The read-only roster shows the machine role token (`owner`, `viewer`) as the visible label, and the role select does the same with `{r}`. No label catalog keyed by OrgRole exists; only a hint table (ROLE_HINT) does, so the internal vocabulary reaches the user's eye.

techniques.evidence: src/features/admin/members/MembersTable.tsx:68 OrgRole is a closed union (src/lib/db/members.ts:18), and coerceStoredRole handles unknown stored values. But layer 3 (label catalog) is missing: the token is rendered raw here, in the select options (line 81 `{r}`), in InviteList.tsx:53 and in AcceptInviteForm.tsx:85.

src/app/invite/[token]/page.tsx:46 The reason-to-copy table is keyed by `string`, not by InvitePeek's reason union (src/lib/db/invites.ts:76). Adding a reason member does not fail the compile; it falls through silently to the `db` copy. AcceptInviteForm.tsx:14 repeats this for acceptInvite's union.

src/features/admin/members/memberTime.ts:20 Relative-by-default with absolute on hover is realized (MembersTable.tsx:111-112 title={absoluteMoment} + timeAgo). But the absolute form takes its locale and timezone from whatever host renders it. timeAgo is also called without nowMs in a client component that is server-rendered first, and it clamps the future to "today" without reporting skew.
src/components/OrgSwitcher.tsx:164 Org names (not authored by the repo) render as React text children with truncation. Identity and selection key on the slug, not on display content.
src/features/admin/members/InviteList.tsx:53 Roles render as uniformly neutral pills. No per-member colour exists in this context, so there is no status-to-colour-role table to judge.
